disposition_definitions.usable: At the legacy sampled-frame resolution, target/event are clear and evidence supports a coarse label.
disposition_definitions.conditional: Some relevant visual evidence exists, but target/event refinement, relabeling, or explicit censoring is required before training.
disposition_definitions.exclude: No stable target/event or insufficient visual evidence to produce trustworthy temporal supervision.
